description: Translate a customer's primary concern into a product recommendation. primary_concern must be one of: blockout, heat, glare, moisture, privacy, security, automation. Optionally narrow by room (bedroom, lounge, etc.), location, budget, and aesthetic. Returns a recommended product_id with rationale, pass it to get_price or configure_product next. For security there is no shop product: it returns a hand-off to our security shutters page (installed in the Garden Route only).

aesthetic.description: Optional style preference, for example modern, natural wood or minimal. Noted with the results

location.description: Optional customer town or suburb. It does not change the results

max_budget_zar.description: Optional most the customer wants to spend per blind, in rand, VAT included. Products whose 1000 x 1000 mm price is above it are left out

primary_concern.description: Main need: blockout (dark rooms), heat, glare, moisture (bathrooms, kitchens), privacy, security (shutters, Garden Route installs only) or automation (motorised)

room.description: Optional room, for example bedroom, lounge, bathroom, kitchen or office

name: get_product_recommendation
title: Recommend a blind
